title: audit flush_buffer double-counts dropped events on commit failure
description: In audit.rs flush_buffer: when individual INSERTs fail (failed_count > 0) AND tx.commit() also fails, the failed-insert events are counted twice — once in the per-INSERT loop (increments AUDIT_EVENTS_DROPPED by failed_count) and again in the commit-failure branch (adds buffer.len() to AUDIT_EVENTS_DROPPED). Trigger: disk-full mid-transaction where some row INSERTs fail before the commit attempt.
